scripts.build:client: bun run embed:skill && bun build packages/client/src/index.ts --compile --outfile dist/saas
scripts.build:client:linux-x64: bun run embed:skill && bun build packages/client/src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/saas-linux-x64
scripts.build:client:linux-arm64: bun run embed:skill && bun build packages/client/src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/saas-linux-arm64
scripts.build:client:darwin-x64: bun run embed:skill && bun build packages/client/src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/saas-darwin-x64
scripts.build:client:darwin-arm64: bun run embed:skill && bun build packages/client/src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/saas-darwin-arm64
scripts.build:client:windows-x64: bun run embed:skill && bun build packages/client/src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/saas-windows-x64.exe
scripts.build:client:all: bun run build:client:linux-x64 && bun run build:client:linux-arm64 && bun run build:client:darwin-x64 && bun run build:client:darwin-arm64 && bun run build:client:windows-x64
scripts.build:server: bun run --cwd packages/server prisma:generate && bun run build:client:all && bun run scripts/build-server.ts
scripts.build:server:postgres: bun run --cwd packages/server prisma:generate:postgres && bun run build:client:all && bun run scripts/build-server.ts
scripts.build:server:current: bun run --cwd packages/server prisma:generate && bun run build:client && bun run scripts/build-server.ts --current-platform
